thread:
incident-bot: Paging oncall: elevated 5xx rate detected on prod gateway cluster 'frontdoor' for path /api/v1/generate. Error rate 5.7% (>3% SLO). Auto-pager: @alina (oncall)

alina (oncall): ACK. Looking now.

sam (sre): pulling traces + logs. seeing a spike of 502/503 from envoy -> backend pool 'inference-svc'. no pod restarts. latency tails up. recent infra change?

jess (infra): i pushed a route-weight adjustment about ~10m ago to finish a canary -> main shift. also increased gateway retry_policy to 2 retries in that rollout. rolling it back now.

alina (oncall): please rollback the weight change and disable gateway retries while we triage.

ops-bot: Deploy rollback started: platform/deploys#4321 -> rollback to revision 6. (initiated by jess) :running:

sam (sre): while rollback runs, temp mitigation: disable retries on the ingress and nudge circuit breaker settings. patch snippets below:

```
# disable retries on frontend envoy via configmap
kubectl -n ingress patch configmap envoy-config --type merge -p \"{\"data\":{\"retry_policy\":\"max_retries: 0\"}}\"
# bump cluster circuit_breaker max_pending_requests
kubectl -n ingress exec deploy/envoy-frontend -- curl -X POST http://localhost:9901/config_dump -d @patch.json
```

marco (frontend): seeing 95p latency spike ~1.2s; prefix cache misses + backend CPU blips align with the start of the weight change.

jess (infra): rollback complete, route weights back to previous. confirming envoy config reloaded.

alina (oncall): metrics: error rate dropping 5.7% -> 1.9% over 3 minutes but not fully healthy yet. any evidence of retry amplification?

sam (sre): yes — logs show gateway retries + backend client retries causing retry storm. disabling gateway retries should cut the amplification. also seeing many upstream overflow / pending request rejections from the CB.

alina (oncall): @jess can you check circuit-breaker thresholds? logs show "upstream overflow" frequently.

jess (infra): we had cluster cb max_pending_requests=100, will bump to 500 temporarily to let backlog drain. applying patch.

ops-bot: Config patch applied: cluster 'frontdoor' circuit_breaker max_pending_requests=500.

alina (oncall): customer impact estimate: approx 0.6% of total requests experienced 5xx during the 18m window. customer reports: acme-corp had two visible spikes. notifying CS to reach out.

sam (sre): quick RCA notes: root cause appears to be a route weight change + relaxed retry policy leading to retry amplification; circuit breaker thresholds then tripped producing a cascade of 5xx. immediate mitigations: rollback weights, disable gateway retries, increase CB limits, and scale inference-svc if needed. follow-ups: (1) gate retry changes behind canary + autoscale checks, (2) add observability for "retry amplification" pattern, (3) update runbook with explicit "disable gateway retries" step. I'll file GH issues.

alina (oncall): staying on 30m watch. if error rate < 0.5% for 15m we close. thanks all.

incident-bot: Incident annotated: severity=sev2, started_ts=6632101234, mitigated_ts=6632101620, handlers=[alina (oncall), sam (sre), jess (infra)].

alina (oncall): closing watch; error rate steady at 0.4% for 20m. filing incident report and assigning follow-ups. :tada:
